7. Subject  to  the  provisions  of  this  Act,  the  Body
Corporate shall be able and capable in law to acquire and
hold  property  both  movable  and  immovable,  which  may
become vested in it by virtue of any purchase, grant, gift,
testamentary disposition or otherwise and all such property
shall be held by the   Body Corporate for the purposes of the
Act  and  subject  to  the  rules  of  the  Body  Corporate  made
under  Section  6,  with  full  power  to  sell,  mortgage,  lease,
exchange, deal with or otherwise dispose of the same .
